lines.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

data.define: Short for "as soon as possible"; used to ask for something quickly.

example.text: Please send me the notes ASAP.

misuse.text: Don't write 'ASAP' to your boss rudely.

native.tip: “ASAP” = lo antes posible; cuanto antes. Ejemplo: “Please send me the notes ASAP.”
native.caption:
¿Qué significa “ASAP”?
“ASAP” = lo antes posible; cuanto antes.
Ejemplo: “Please send me the notes ASAP.” (Por favor, envíame las notas 'ASAP'.)
